translations.web: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
translations.bsb: If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption in proportion to his purchase price.
translations.kjv: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought
translations.asv: If there be yet many years, according unto them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
